nodes.title: SG-5.3.1 · Scene start plays the authored fade transition
nodes.body:
Context: buildEffects (game/src/engine/buildEffects.ts) skips 'transition' effect specs and says they are played through ctx.playTransition, but nothing calls playTransition. BootScene.create (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) only builds effects, so no fade plays although bedroom.yaml authors a fade transition. Desired behavior: on scene start the authored fade is played with its content duration, and nothing is played when the scene has no transition entry. Why: the fade scene transition is part of the content-driven effects requirement.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene with a fade transition entry of 400 ms, when the scene starts, then playTransition is called once with 400.
- Given a scene with no transition entry, when the scene starts, then playTransition is not called.


## Scope
- In scope: Engine helper that reads the transition entry and calls ctx.playTransition
- In scope: BootScene.create calling that helper
- In scope: Unit tests with a mocked effect context
- Out of scope: New transition kinds
- Out of scope: Changing the effects schema
- Out of scope: Changing the Phaser camera fade implementation
- Preserve: buildEffects keeps skipping transition specs
- Preserve: BootScene shutdown cleanup and sceneReady event


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90
- Engine code in game/src/engine must not import Phaser; it uses EffectRenderContext


## Definition of done
- Both requirements have Act and Verify units merged and green


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · An engine helper plays the scene's authored fade with its content duration
nodes.body:
Context: EffectSpec has a { type: 'transition', kind: 'fade', durationMs } variant (game/src/content/schema.ts L14) and SceneDef.effects holds it. Desired behavior: a pure engine helper finds the transition spec and calls ctx.playTransition(durationMs); it does nothing when absent. Expected result: the duration comes from content, never hardcoded. Why: keeps runtime separate from content.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene.effects contains a fade transition with durationMs 400, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is called once with 400.
- Given scene.effects is undefined or has no transition entry, when playSceneTransition runs, then ctx.playTransition is never called.


## Scope
- In scope: New game/src/engine/playSceneTransition.ts
- Out of scope: Phaser-specific code
- Preserve: buildEffects behavior


## Technical constraints
- Use EffectRenderContext from game/src/engine/renderContext.ts


## Definition of done
- Helper exported and used by BootScene


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene.create plays the authored transition on scene start
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create builds effects but never plays the fade. Desired behavior: create() calls playSceneTransition with the same Phaser effect context used for buildEffects. Expected result: the bedroom fades in over its authored duration. Why: no fade plays today.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create runs, then playSceneTransition is called once with the effect context and the bundled scene.
- Given the scene shuts down, then effect handles are still destroyed.


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.create wiring
- Out of scope: New scenes
- Preserve: Subscription cleanup
- Preserve: sceneReady emit


## Technical constraints
- Reuse a single createPhaserEffectContext(this) instance


## Definition of done
- BootScene calls the helper


## Clarifying questions
- None
